name: Sound Editor
description: The map's sounds and music (war3map.w3s): browse and play the game's and imported sound files, add them as sounds or music, edit their settings (effect, channel, volume, pitch, 3D distances and cones) like the World Editor's Sound Editor.

mcpTools.name: set_sound
mcpTools.description: Adds a sound or music to the map from a sound file of the game or of the map's imports, or changes the one of that name, as one edit: the open Sound Editor shows it at once, and the map script declares it as its name (gg_snd_...), for triggers to play. A new sound needs file; a game sound with a sound label takes the label's settings, as in the World Editor. Numbers the Sound Editor refuses are refused. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

name.description: The sound's variable name, with or without gg_snd_. Left out for a new sound, it is named after its file.

file.description: The sound file, as the map names it: a game file like Sound\Ambient\RainAmbience.flac (search_game_files finds them) or an imported one like war3mapImported\Horn.mp3 (list_imports).

music.description: A new entry only: add it as music.

is3d.description: A 3D sound, heard from a place.

channel.description: One of the game's sound channels (0 General, 8 Music, ...); -1 for a labelled sound's own.

minDistance.description: 3D sounds: 0 to 100000; null for the default.

maxDistance.description: 3D sounds: 0 to 100000; null for the default.

distanceCutoff.description: 3D sounds: 0 to 100000; null for the default.

mcpTools.name: remove_sound
mcpTools.description: Removes a sound or music from the map's list, as one edit. Its file stays, and triggers that use it are not changed: list_problems shows them. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: list_sounds
mcpTools.description: The open map's sounds and music (war3map.w3s): variable name, file, options, channel, effect, volume, fade rates, pitch and 3D distances; a number left out is unset (the sound label's or the game's default applies).

commands.title: Sound Editor: Rename or Delete a Sound

services.description: The map's sounds as the open Sound Editor holds them (unsaved changes included): liveSounds, onDidEdit.
